title: Vortex fluidic device-driven production of medium-chain free fatty acids for organic cosmetic ingredients
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, 4,315-327
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00610D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xuejiao Cao, Caterina Selva, Jonathan A. Campbell, Vincent Bulone, Xuan Luo, M. Ajanth Praveen, Youhong Tang, Colin L. Raston
Sustainable production of MCFFAs from Palmester oil is achieved using vortex fluidic technology, delivering 95% yield and 96% purity. The resulting MCFFAs show strong antibacterial activity and properties suited to organic cosmetics.
